verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an API-first product. It has a documented public product-data API with a v1 search reference, free API keys without OAuth, an SDK, a CLI that calls the API, and published per-call pricing. A community developer reports building a product on top of it, which corroborates real programmatic use. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
